en-US: Build 200 internal device test. This replaces Build 199, which stopped before App compilation because the updated Office native host had not yet been repinned; Build 199 was not uploaded. The rebuilt and source-verified Office host is now included. Please focus on: (1) Canvas nodes move when dragging the body/title with finger or trackpad; only visible corners resize. (2) Video/image tasks support correct model selection, explicit refresh/reconciliation, and recover from temporary status failures. (3) Office no longer remains on 'Closing'; preview-to-edit can be repeated, known Notes documents reopen in edit mode, Office remains in the current IDE tab, and File Manager expand opens the dedicated editor. (4) Local MLX releases model/Metal caches each turn, drops obsolete vision state for text turns, and performs one clean retry per turn for load/decode failures. (5) Shell has bounded output finalization and interactive Dash input. Build 198 mind-map and Magic Keyboard fixes remain included. Validation is intentionally short: focused host/source checks and one cloud App build; full UI/device acceptance is assigned to the tester. No public beta submission is included.
zh-Hans: Build 200 内部真机测试。本版替代 Build 199；Build 199 因更新后的 Office 原生组件尚未重新锁定，在 App 编译前即停止，未上传。Build 200 已包含重新构建并核对来源的 Office 组件。请重点验证：① 手指或触控板拖动画布节点主体／标题可移动，只有可见四角调整大小。② 视频／图片任务可正确选模型、主动刷新和恢复，临时状态查询失败不会误判任务失败。③ Office 不再卡在“正在关闭”；预览转编辑可重复使用；手记中已打开过的文档再次进入默认编辑；Office 留在当前 IDE 标签内；文件管理器放大直接进入专用编辑器。④ 本地 MLX 每轮释放模型与 Metal 缓存，纯文字轮释放无用视觉状态，加载／解码失败每轮只自动清理重试一次。⑤ Shell 输出收尾有界并修复 Dash 交互输入。Build 198 的思维导图和妙控键盘修复继续包含。本轮按要求缩短验证：只做聚焦宿主／源码检查和一次云端 App 构建，完整 UI／真机验收由测试者完成。本轮不提交公开 Beta。
